description: Metric with baseline band and per-point anomaly state markers (normal/warning/outlier)
name: Anomaly Overlay
query_shape: Columns: time, value, baseline_mean, baseline_lower, baseline_upper, anomaly_state
sample_sql:
SELECT
  time,
  value,
  baseline_mean,
  baseline_lower,
  baseline_upper,
  anomaly_state
FROM v_otel_metrics_anomaly
WHERE ServiceName = 'my-service'
  AND MetricName = 'my.metric'
  AND time >= now() - INTERVAL 6 HOUR
ORDER BY time

name: Distribution Box Plot
query_shape: Columns: dimension, min, q1, median, q3, max
sample_sql:
SELECT
  HTTPMethod AS dimension,
  min(Duration) AS min,
  quantile(0.25)(Duration) AS q1,
  quantile(0.5)(Duration) AS median,
  quantile(0.75)(Duration) AS q3,
  max(Duration) AS max
FROM otel_traces
GROUP BY HTTPMethod
ORDER BY median DESC

description: At-a-glance signal health view with recent focus, anomaly windows, and status summary
name: Derived Signal Overlay
query_shape: Columns: time, service, source, signal, attr_fp, value, sample_count, baseline_mean, baseline_lower, baseline_upper, anomaly_state, anomaly_score
sample_sql:
SELECT
  time,
  ServiceName AS service,
  SignalSource AS source,
  SignalName AS signal,
  AttrFingerprint AS attr_fp,
  value,
  SampleCount AS sample_count,
  baseline_mean,
  baseline_lower,
  baseline_upper,
  anomaly_state,
  anomaly_score
FROM v_derived_signals_anomaly
WHERE ServiceName = 'trace-svc-0'
  AND SignalSource = 'traces'
  AND SignalName = 'latency_p95_ms'
  AND time >= now() - INTERVAL 6 HOUR
ORDER BY time

description: Compare metric vs anomaly detection signal on dual axes
name: Metric + Anomaly Score
sample_sql:
SELECT
  time,
  value AS metric,
  anomaly_score
FROM v_otel_metrics_anomaly
WHERE ServiceName = 'my-service'
  AND MetricName = 'my.metric'
  AND time >= now() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR
ORDER BY time

description: Single-value gauge for KPI monitoring (SLA %, uptime %)
name: KPI Gauge
sample_sql:
SELECT
  round(100.0 * countIf(StatusCode = 'STATUS_CODE_OK') / count(), 2) AS value
FROM otel_traces
WHERE Timestamp > now() - interval 1 hour

description: 2D heatmap for correlating errors across dimensions
name: Heatmap
query_shape: Columns: x category, y time bucket, numeric value
sample_sql:
SELECT
  ServiceName AS x_category,
  toStartOfFiveMinutes(Timestamp) AS y_category,
  round(100.0 * countIf(StatusCode = 'STATUS_CODE_ERROR') / count(), 2) AS value
FROM otel_traces
GROUP BY ServiceName, y_category
ORDER BY ServiceName, y_category

description: Show metric with percentile bands for anomaly detection
name: Time Series with Normal Range
sample_sql:
SELECT
  toStartOfMinute(Timestamp) AS time,
  avg(Duration) AS value,
  quantile(0.95)(Duration) AS p95,
  quantile(0.99)(Duration) AS p99
FROM otel_traces
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time
